newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks end up, led by properties, banks.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks end up, led by properties, banks.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks ended higher for the third day in a row on Friday, with a rally in property and bank stocks keeping the Hang Seng Index well above 13,000 points, although momentum began to slow after a strong week.

The Hang Seng ended 60.92 points, or 0.47 percent, higher at 13,081.70 after reaching a session high of 13,145.93. The index put on 435.94 points, or 3.45 percent, this week. Turnover was HK$13.77 billion compared with HK$12.50 billion on Thursday.
"I think the overall market has resumed its uptrend after the last few weeks of consolidation," said Alex Tang, head of research at Yamaichi International.
